title: ci(test-ui): state what bounds a planned leg, and warn when the lane passes D
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb2LA2JnEAZZtpjjP7Vho5eB)_

Fixes #31965

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 本 PR 修 #31962 合同评审记录 6745712800 的两个 nit。
  - F1：`ci.yml` 中 `test-ui-plan` 的头注释原说「每一路都不比全量的一路更密」。这句对常驻通道不成立，现在改成实际成立的说法。规划器在通道的预测秒数超过 D 时打一条 `::warning::`。
  - F2：wiring 测试按 vitest 文件名过滤器的规则（不分大小写的子串）把每一路的参数还原成文件，并新增一对 `x.test.ts` / `X.test.tsx` 夹具钉住这条规则。
- **为什么改:** 门禁的注释只能说真话。另外，今后若出现互为子串的测试路径，wiring 测试不应误报红。
- **风险与回滚:** 任何一路跑的文件都不变。警告只打提示，不拒绝、不变红；今天的通道是 1,731 s，低于 D = 1,856 s，所以今天不会出现。回滚就是 revert，不用改设置。
- **先看:** `ui/scripts/plan-test-ui-shards.mjs` 的警告；`ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` 的 `PAIR` 夹具和 `ranBy()`。
- **两分钟验证:** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/plan-test-ui-shards.test.ts scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`
- **需要你做的:** 无设置变更。`ci.yml` 只改了注释，分级以席位核定为准。

## What changes

- **The `test-ui-plan` header in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`** (a comment only). It used to say "so no planned leg is denser than a full-battery leg". It now says what holds:
  - the bins average at most D, a full-battery leg's own mean;
  - that can fail only when a cap binds:
    - the 15 bin slots, which bounds the average at 16/15 of D, because the rest never weighs more than the whole suite;
    - or a file heavier than D, which no split divides;
  - the lane is not sized to D: it weighs what the always-on set predicts, and the planner warns when that passes D.

  No job graph, permission, name or step changes.
- **`ui/scripts/plan-test-ui-shards.mjs`:**
  - When an affected plan's lane predicts more than D, `plan` prints `::warning title=Test UI always-on lane::…` naming both figures. It is a warning, never a refusal, and the plan is unchanged.
  - The header's two density sentences now say the same thing as `ci.yml`.
- **`ui/scripts/__tests__/plan-test-ui-shards.test.ts`:**
  - A new case runs the CLI with a lane under D (no warning) and a lane over D (the warning, with the plan still written and its lane intact).
  - One test title changes from "no planned leg is denser than a full-battery leg" to what its body asserts, the count rule. The body itself is unchanged.
- **`ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`:**
  - `ranBy()` expands each leg's positionals over the stand-in collection the way vitest's filename filter matches: a case-insensitive substring of the path relative to the ui root. The lane check and the "each selected file exactly once" check now compare files rather than argv.
  - The stand-in `vitest list` also matches case-insensitively now.
  - A `PAIR` fixture is added to the collection and the selector's verdict: `x.test.ts` and `X.test.tsx`, a filter pair with a case-only difference. The selector keeps one filter for the pair and lists both files as always-on.
  - The pull_request case also pins that the lane leg's argv carries `x.test.ts` and not `X.test.tsx`.

### Was the warning noise?

No. On today's tree it does not fire for any measured selection:

| Selection | Lane predicted-s | D |
|---|---:|---:|
| Empty diff | 1,731 | 1,856 |
| `apps/console` change | 1,587 | 1,856 |
| `plugin-kanban` change | 1,327 | 1,856 |

It fires only once the always-on set outgrows a full-battery leg, which is exactly when slot 1 becomes the run's slowest leg.

## Proof

- **Red without the fix:** with the `PAIR` fixture added but the comparisons as on `main` (raw argv), the wiring test reds "a pull_request plans the selected files into N slots…": `expected [ …(511) ] to deeply equal [ …(512) ]`. The lane leg's argv carries the pair's shorter path alone. On this branch the test is green.
- **Ablations:**

  | Ablation | Result |
  |---|---|
  | `matches()` made case-sensitive | 7 wiring cases red |
  | The planner's warning branch disabled | the new planner case red |

- **Tests:** `plan-test-ui-shards.test.ts` 26 pass; `select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` 16 pass.
